prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Houston for a car wreck?
ai_overview_text:
There is no single "best" lawyer for every car wreck, as the right choice depends on your specific injuries, whether fault is disputed, and whether the case settles or goes to trial. www.forthepeople.com +2
Several prominent and highly-rated personal injury firms and trial lawyers in Houston handle car and motor vehicle accidents:
Board-Certified & Trial Experience: Attorney Brian White Personal Injury Lawyers is led by Brian White, who is Board Certified in Personal Injury Trial Law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization and has a background representing insurance companies.
High-Stakes & Large Verdicts: Zehl & Associates Injury & Accident Lawyers handles major commercial and motor vehicle accident litigation with a track record of large verdicts and settlements in Texas.
National & Local Reach: Morgan & Morgan is a massive national firm with a dedicated office and local presence in Houston handling auto accident claims on a contingency fee basis ($0 upfront). www.forthepeople.com
Longstanding Local Practice: Attorney Steve Lee has served the Houston area for over 50 years, representing clients in car, truck, and rideshare accident cases. Attorney Steve Lee
Recognized Trial Lawyers: Forbes Advisor highlights prominent Houston trial attorneys such as Jason A. Itkin (The Lanier Law Firm), Randall O. Sorrels, and Robert E. Ammons for high-stakes injury litigation. Forbes
Contingency Fee: Most car wreck lawyers work on contingency (you pay no upfront fees, and they take a percentage—typically around 33% to 40%—only if they recover money for you). The Reeves Law Group +1
Board Certification: Look for attorneys certified in Personal Injury Trial Law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization.
Insurance Background: Attorneys who previously worked for insurance defense firms often understand how insurance adjusters evaluate and try to undervalue claims.
